title: Harbor Bank settles lawsuit
author: Dana Reyes
body: Harbor Bank agreed on Tuesday to pay $40 million to settle a class action. Chief executive Maria Chen said the bank admitted no wrongdoing. The settlement ends a three-year dispute.

title: Tech giant unveils AI chip
body: Nova Systems unveiled the Aurora chip on Monday. Analysts said the Aurora chip doubles training speed. Nova Systems shares rose five percent.

title: Nova Systems faces antitrust probe
author: Lee Park
body: Regulators opened an antitrust probe into Nova Systems on Tuesday. The probe follows complaints about the Aurora chip bundle.

title: Marathon record falls in Berlin
author: Sam Ortiz
body: Kelvin Rono won the Berlin marathon in 2:01:09, a new world best. Rono led from the 30 kilometre mark.

title: Quiet week for markets
author: Dana Reyes
body: Markets ended a quiet week little changed. Traders awaited the central bank decision.
